language.option.SKY_AMBIENT.comment: Diffuse skylight brightness. Expanded range reaches very dark and deliberately bright looks; source default1.40.
language.option.ambientOcclusionLevel.comment: Vanilla corner AO, default and maximum 1.00; does not raise exposure.
language.option.SURFACE_SATURATION.comment: 1.00 preserves vanilla saturation. Lighting, absorption and bloom still affect the final image.
language.option.SURFACE_DAMPNESS.comment: Matte moisture absorption follows porosity, face drainage, sky exposure, humidity and rain. No environmental reflections, glossy film, corner outlines or random noise.
language.option.LAMP_LEVEL.comment: Diffuse local brightness and emissive pixel interiors, with adjustable subtle bloom.
language.option.LAMP_HEAT.comment: A restrained amber bias where block lighting dominates.
language.option.CLOUD_AMOUNT.comment: Density/coverage strength of the current vanilla cloud footprint. Zero hides the lower layer; high clouds are independent. The footprint is preserved at every nonzero value.
language.option.CLOUD_SPAN.comment: Scale of the current vanilla cloud footprint. Default 240 gives 12-block texture cells; changing scale preserves its connected shapes.
language.option.CLOUD_DISTORTION.comment: Gentle vertical relief within connected clouds. Never warps or erodes the vanilla horizontal footprint.
language.option.CLOUD_RELIEF.comment: Self-shadowing and smooth light/dark depth within the simple connected cloud forms.
language.option.CLOUD_LAYERS.comment: Cloud shape, integration and self-shadow sampling. High is the reference-quality default; lower values trade detail for speed.
language.option.MIST_AMOUNT.comment: Outdoor mist opacity. Cave surfaces without skylight reject valley mist.
language.option.MIST_Y.comment: World Y of the principal pale horizontal mist layer.
language.option.MIST_THICKNESS.comment: Height/depth of drifting3D fog pockets and valley layers, adjustable from thin banks to deep mist.
language.option.MIST_CLEAR.comment: Clear range before volumetric fog begins. Default24blocks lets nearby pockets show depth while the immediate foreground remains clear.
language.option.MIST_DETAIL.comment: Sampling detail for broad horizontal density patches.
language.option.REFLECT_LEVEL.comment: Scales above-water angle-dependent dielectric reflection. 1.00 uses physical Fresnel. The underwater interface remains transparent without a reflection overlay.
language.option.REFLECTION_MODE.comment: Sky fallback,32-step scenery tracing, or96-step high-quality tracing with precise hits. Hidden geometry remains a screen-space limitation.
language.option.REFLECT_RANGE.comment: Misses fade to the procedural sky, including at screen borders.
language.option.WATER_VISIBILITY.comment: 1.70 is the default. Higher values reduce optical extinction. Actual visibility also responds to biome sediment, rain runoff and shelter.
language.option.WATER_EXTINCTION.comment: Absorption and sediment scattering along the actual water segment. Underwater fog stops at the visible exit; air beyond it adds no water absorption.
language.option.RIPPLE_HEIGHT.comment: Shading normal amplitude. Water geometry remains vanilla.
language.option.RIPPLE_SIZE.comment: Scale of the four unequal spectral wave components.
language.option.FACE_SHADING.comment: Contrast of vanilla face shading with a restrained 35% realistic sky/ground/sun contribution on exposed faces. Zero disables face contrast.
language.option.BLOOM_STRENGTH.comment: Visible restrained light halos. Emissive masking protects ordinary entities and white blocks from glowing.
language.option.CLOUD_ALTITUDE.comment: World height of the cloud layer centre. Fly below, through and above it.
language.option.CLOUD_THICKNESS.comment: Vertical thickness in blocks. Default 12 keeps connected vanilla shapes low and simple; 4 approaches vanilla slab proportions. Existing thicker values remain available.
language.option.SKY_LEAK.comment: Broad daylight glow through the cloud ceiling. Sun visibility separately controls the haze-softened solar core.
language.option.WET_SHEEN.comment: Extra diffuse moisture absorption on porous, partially sheltered faces. Legacy WET_SHEEN values are retained; solid blocks stay matte at every value.
language.option.BLOOM_RADIUS.comment: Restrained halo width, stable relative to image height. Bloom strength remains a separate control.
language.option.SUN_VISIBILITY.comment: Brightness of the polished blocky sun behind clouds. Zero hides its textured core; broad sky haze remains.
language.option.FACE_BLEND.comment: Blend from unshaded faces to vanilla-dominant face shading with subtle directional light. Zero bypasses it.
language.option.GROUND_WARMTH.comment: Golden sunlight only on outward sun-facing block faces, weighted by skylight and nearby visible occluders. No brown tint on all sides.
language.option.WATER_DISTORTION.comment: Controls the ripple distortion seen through water from above. Underwater uses a straight-through view without Snell refraction; Ripple height adjusts the shared surface shape.
language.option.CIRRUS_AMOUNT.comment: Strength of a sky-wide wispy veil, independent of lower cloud coverage and shapes. Zero hides the upper layer.
language.option.CIRRUS_ALTITUDE.comment: World altitude of the upper wispy cloud layer.
language.option.CLOUD_STYLE.comment: Stratus extrudes the running game's current cloud texture with simple forms and soft shading. Vanilla uses actual fancy cloud geometry. Off hides both.
language.option.SUN_STYLE.comment: Choose Minecraft's blocky sun with HDR warmth and soft haze, or unchanged native sun and moon textures.
language.option.BIOME_WATER.comment: Vanilla biome tint plus smoothed sediment, humidity, temperature, rain runoff and local cave lighting. These are visual approximations, not measured sediment data.
language.option.WATER_TURBIDITY.comment: Scattering from suspended particles. Swamps and rainy rivers carry more sediment; sheltered cave water rejects rain runoff.
language.option.REFRACTION_QUALITY.comment: Higher levels improve shoreline protection above water and the search for terrain viewed through the surface from underwater. Fast retains the original above-water depth guard.
language.option.CLOUD_DENSITY.comment: Optical density of the simple cloud volumes. Lower-layer shapes come from the active vanilla/resource-pack cloud texture.
language.option.CLOUD_DETAIL.comment: Broad smooth density gradients within simple connected clouds. Fine pores and noisy billows have been removed.
language.option.MIST_SCALE.comment: World-space size of drifting3D fog banks. Smaller values produce more local pockets; larger values broad valley structures.
language.option.MIST_BREAKUP.comment: Zero makes smooth fog; higher values create distinct connected pockets and gaps. Shape remains anchored in3D world space.
language.option.MIST_LIGHT.comment: Directional sunlight scattered by fog, with internal extinction. Independent of fog density.
language.option.WET_DARKENING.comment: Darkening strength on absorbent soil, timber, stone, fabric and masonry. Metals/glazed surfaces have no pore darkening. Wet sheen is separate.
language.option.EXPOSURE.comment: Camera brightness in stops, affecting terrain, sky, water and bloom together. +1 doubles scene light; HUD is unchanged.
language.option.ATMOSPHERE_QUALITY.comment: Cloud and fog image quality, independent of water reflections. Balanced retains volume detail at lower rendering cost.
language.option.WATER_RENDER_QUALITY.comment: Resolution of water surface optics. Balanced uses half resolution with depth and normal aware reconstruction. Opaque terrain and submerged blocks seen directly remain full resolution.
